subject: Evaluation & MAP: Borealis analytics - commit/ramp & vendor price comparison
messages:
From: Lina Costa <lina@borealisanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@borealisanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Evaluating Redwood - MAP & vendor bids

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency profile and the model control features. We're building an evaluation plan to prove out inference economics and reliability for a production recommendation service.

Quick ask: can you send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out evaluation milestones, expected ramp, and the commercial terms tied to each milestone? Procurement wants to see a clear close timeline so they can align budget.

A few context points from our side:
- We're comparing Redwood with Lumina AI (they've given us a preliminary price of $0.004/token and a 30% onboarding credit for the first quarter).
- Target go-live window: mid-November (so ~4 months from now).
- Evaluation scope: 3-month pilot (up to 25M tokens), then ramp to steady-state over next 3 months.

If you can include a clear table that maps commits (months 1-6), associated discounts, and any ramp/credit mechanics, that would speed our internal approvals. Also, can you confirm what you'd need from us (data access, security questionnaires, PoV success criteria)?

Attachment: RFP_Q3_scoping.pdf (outline of evaluation metrics and data flows)

Best,
Lina Costa
Director of ML Platforms
Borealis Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Costa <lina@borealisanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@borealisanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-18 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood - MAP & vendor bids

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear context and the RFP. Really excited to partner on this.

Attached is a draft MAP (Proposed_MAP_Borealis_v1.xlsx) that maps a 3-month evaluation into a 6-month ramp with commercial milestones. Highlights:
- Pilot (Months 0-3): up to 25M tokens, complimentary onboarding support and a $10k credit for model tuning (to accelerate evaluation).
- Ramp (Months 4-6): recommended commit tiers: $20k/mo -> $40k/mo -> $60k/mo. Discounts applied as unit price reductions at each tier.
- Price match consideration: we can match Lumina's $0.004/token if you commit to a 12-month term at or above the $60k/mo tier OR we can offer a staged price-match (first 6 months at $0.004, then standard tiered pricing) for a 12-month agreement.
- SLAs & observability: 99.9% uptime target, token-level cost dashboards, and per-route latency p95 alerts included for dedicated customers.

What we'll need from you: signed MAP, SOC2 attestation (if not already shared), a shared test dataset access window, and internal success criteria (latency target, quality thresholds).

I've also included a column that ties each milestone to the commercial deliverable (credits, pricing, support). Let me know which pricing cadence you prefer — full 12-month price match vs. 6-month introductory match + standard ramp.

Next steps: if procurement is comfortable, we can lock commercial terms and circulate redlines for legal. If you'd like, I can copy in our finance lead to run a quick margin/commit check.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Proposed_MAP_Borealis_v1.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19 08:21 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Borealis MAP - pricing match request (need greenlight)

Team — forwarding the ask from Borealis. Key excerpt: they want us to match Lumina's $0.004/token (Lumina offered 30% onboarding credit + $0.004 base). Their ideal: 9–12 month committed term with ramp.

Quick analysis:
- Our listed public unit (hosted) is $0.005/token; dedicated pricing typically provides room for negotiation.
- If we match $0.004 flat for 12 months at a $60k/mo commit, margin is thin but feasible if we: (a) require upfront quarterly billing or (b) add a small platform fee / minimum monthly usage.
- Alternatives: staged match (6 months at $0.004 then revert to tiered pricing), or offer equivalent commercial value via onboarding credits + extended support instead of pure unit-cost match.

Ask: Logan — can you run a quick margin/pricing sensitivity? Aditya — if we go with a staged match we should confirm what observability/SLAs we attach; legal will need to limit indemnities.

I'll tell Borealis we can tentatively match under a 12-month commit OR provide a 6-month intro match if finance signs off. We should keep a documented MAP with explicit ramp milestones tied to billing triggers (e.g., trigger full commit after month 3 acceptance).

—Marissa
From: Lina Costa <lina@borealisanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@borealisanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-22 14:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood - MAP & vendor bids

Marissa — thanks for the proposal and the MAP. The team liked the onboarding credits and the observability pieces. A few follow-ups:

1) Pricing: Lumina has formally quoted $0.004/token with a 12-month term and a 30% onboarding credit for Q1. Borealis procurement has asked whether Redwood can match $0.004 with a 9-month ramp and a 12-month term OR offer an equivalent commercial package (credits + SLA) that comes to the same TCO over 12 months. Please provide a simple model comparing total spend across the two proposals.

2) Feature parity: procurement wants a short matrix comparing capabilities we care about (prefix caching, KV cache behavior, dedicated latency SLOs, VPC private deployment). I attached a competitor_matrix.pdf that Lumina gave us — can you fill in Redwood's parity notes?

3) Close timeline: procurement needs the signed MAP + PO by 2026-07-30 to hit their budget cycle. Can you confirm you can meet that timing if we accept a 12-month term?

Attachment: competitor_matrix.pdf

Thanks — if possible, please add a one-page commercial summary we can drop into our procurement deck.

Best,
Lina
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Costa <lina@borealisanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@borealisanalytics.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-23 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood - MAP & vendor bids

Lina — thank you and appreciate the clear asks. Apologies for the slightly long note but want to be explicit so procurement has a clean doc for the PO.

Summary: Redwood can match Lumina's $0.004/token under one of two pathways — please pick which you prefer and we'll circulate legal redlines immediately:

Option A — 12-month committed term (preferred):
- Commit: $60,000/month (billed quarterly upfront)
- Unit price: $0.004/token for the full 12 months
- Onboarding: 20% credit applied to first quarter spend (we can increase to 30% if you sign by 2026-07-30 and accept a 12-month autopay clause)
- Deliverables: dedicated onboarding playbook, two escalation contacts, and access to Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization profiles during pilot
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime; p95 latency targets per-route; penalty credits for SLA breaches capped at 10% of quarterly invoice.

Option B — Intro match + ramp (lower commitment):
- Pilot: 3 months (as discussed) with $10k tuning credit
- Intro price: $0.004/token for months 1–6; then tiered pricing after month 6 unless a 12-month commit is signed.
- Commit requirement to convert to long-term pricing: >= $40k/month at month 7 with a minimum 9-month follow-on term.

Feature parity & TCO: attached is a one-page commercial summary and a filled competitor matrix. The spend model compares Lumina's quote vs. Option A and Option B over 12 months — high level: Option A with the increased onboarding credit nets out within ~2% of Lumina's quoted TCO if signed by 7/30.

Next steps:
1) Tell me which option procurement prefers.
2) If Option A, we'll update the MAP and route to legal for redlines (I will include our finance contact to confirm quarterly billing).
3) If you'd like the 30% onboarding credit, confirm by 2026-07-30 and we'll include that in the redline.

Attachments: Final_MAP_Borealis_20260723.xlsx, Commercial_Terms_BOR_DEAL-2026-047.pdf

Link to PO/Docusign when ready: https://www.docusign.net/envelopes/XYZ-ENVELOPE-8891

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
